justification: The golden-fixture capture for SEPP housing eligibility measured lot width from the raw cadastral frontage while the live brief measures it battleaxe-aware, so the captured fixture disagreed with the brief on flag lots and asserted a stale 'width unconfirmed' outcome. This is regulatory-facing eligibility representation, so the capture must mirror the brief and the test must assert the corrected battleaxe resolution across metro/regional and dataset-gap cases.

pre_impl.existing_data: The brief already resolves the developable head width for a battleaxe lot via eligibility_lot_width (added in #720) and feeds it to evaluate_eligibility, but the fixture capture still passed dims.frontage_m, which is the null access-handle width on a flag lot, so the captured Bowral fixture kept the pre-#720 unconfirmed result.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Confirmed against the live production intelligence-brief stream for 38 Park Road Bowral: lot_width_m came back 70.09 m and secondary_dwelling eligible true, while the committed fixture said width unconfirmed and secondary_dwelling ineligible, proving the capture had diverged from the brief.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new capability; the capture reuses the same eligibility_lot_width helper the brief uses, and the null-width conservative contract stays covered by existing unit tests in test_housing_sepp_eligibility.py rather than by this regenerated real-lot fixture.

functions.name: capture_housing_sepp_bowral
functions.input: no arguments; fetches the Bowral lot geometry, valuation, and computes lot dimensions from live NSW sources
functions.output: writes the housing SEPP eligibility golden fixture using the battleaxe-aware head width that the brief itself passes to the engine
functions.if_none: when geometry or dimensions are missing eligibility_lot_width returns None and the engine falls back to its conservative unconfirmed path unchanged

values.read_at: capture_housing_sepp_bowral now derives the width from lot dimensions exactly as the brief does before calling evaluate_eligibility
values.if_missing: a None width flows into the engine and yields a conservative unconfirmed and ineligible row rather than a false eligible result

break_it.scenario: A future edit reverts the capture width source back to the raw cadastral frontage while the brief keeps the battleaxe-aware width
break_it.what_happens: the fixture would again show width unconfirmed on a flag lot while the live brief marks it eligible, silently re-diverging the golden capture from production
break_it.how: the reframed test asserts no form reports width-unconfirmed on this resolvable battleaxe lot and that secondary_dwelling and dual_occupancy are eligible, so a frontage revert fails the test
break_it.repro: change the capture width back to dims.frontage_m, regenerate, and run the Bowral golden test

break_it.scenario: A genuinely widthless lot arrives where the geometry cannot yield any developable width at all
break_it.what_happens: an eager eligible result would over-report buildability on a lot whose width was never measured
break_it.how: eligibility_lot_width returns None and the engine keeps its conservative unconfirmed-ineligible path, which the unit tests in test_housing_sepp_eligibility.py continue to assert
break_it.repro: run test_missing_width_is_unconfirmed_but_still_conservatively_ineligible in the eligibility unit suite

break_it.scenario: A form whose standard is absent from the dataset, such as manor_house, is mislabelled as eligible or as a measured failure
break_it.what_happens: a dataset gap would masquerade as a confirmed regulatory outcome and mislead the reader on that form
break_it.how: the reframed test requires every unconfirmed row to stay ineligible and to carry a dataset reason, separating a dataset gap from a width gap
break_it.repro: inspect the manor_house row in the regenerated fixture and confirm unconfirmed true, eligible false, reason mentions dataset

post_merge.manual_verify: Fixture regenerated from the live production brief for 38 Park Road Bowral (secondary_dwelling and dual_occupancy eligible, width 70.09 m); 19 golden-fixture tests and 27 eligibility unit tests pass. Local re-capture via the script needs DATABASE_URL, which is absent in this environment; the capture-script fix is verified by reading, the values by the live stream. Known follow-up: evaluate_eligibility does not test a minimum access-way width for battleaxe lots — needs the exact SEPP clause sourced before adding, per the no-hardcode rule.
